hook: Gold changed your wedding budget overnight.

storyboard.visual: Bangle emerges from black; rising amber waveform flashes alive.
Camera pushes through the bangle into the rising light trace.
Three clean symbols assemble: global gold → rupee → jewellery price.
Return to bangle; price tag swings once, then settles.

voiceover: Gold can move before your jeweller opens. Global gold sets the base. The rupee changes the Indian quote. Markets become moments. BhaavBrief.
caption: A gold price is not just a number on a screen. It reaches the jewellery counter through global gold and the rupee. Educational data, not investment advice.
